d:
Sonam Wangchuk has claimed that he has been placed under house arrest in Ladakh, triggering fresh controversy over the upcoming Autonomous Hill Development Council (LAHDC) elections.
Wangchuk alleges that security personnel have been deployed outside his residence and his movement has been restricted. However, the police maintain that this is not a formal house arrest but action under election-related restrictions.
But why are Wangchuk and other Ladakh leaders opposing the December 4 elections?
